definitions.explanation: A dog that is kept inside the house rather than outdoors. In modern Japan, most pet dogs are kept indoors.

examples.japanese: うちの{犬|いぬ}は{室内犬|しつないけん}です。
examples.english: Our dog is an indoor dog.

examples.japanese: {室内犬|しつないけん}には{小型犬|こがたけん}が{向|む}いている。
examples.english: Small breeds are suited for keeping indoors.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{大型犬|おおがたけん}でも{室内犬|しつないけん}として{飼|か}う{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, more people are keeping even large dogs as indoor dogs.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {室内|しつない} (indoors) and {犬|けん} (dog). Reflects the modern Japanese trend of keeping dogs inside the home rather than in an outdoor kennel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {室内犬|しつないけん}として{飼|か}う (to keep as an indoor dog)
- {室内犬|しつないけん}に{向|む}いている (suited for keeping indoors)
- {室内犬|しつないけん}{向|む}けの{犬種|けんしゅ} (dog breeds suitable for indoor living)

RELATED WORDS:
- {室外犬|しつがいけん}: outdoor dog
- {番犬|ばんけん}: guard dog
- {愛犬|あいけん}: pet dog, beloved dog
